description: Ministry of Higher Education - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2015/06, entering Department of Information Systems and Department of Chemical Sciences  to the Rajarata University
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of a university's academic departments through a legal order issued under the Universities Act. It constitutes a regulatory change to the established framework of a higher education institution, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Minister's name is incidental to the legal/regulatory action being taken.
